regions.note: Structural: says the scores are DERIVED from the inputs.

invariants: Discs are EQUAL. This template is for a narrow range with the number printed; at 85-99 square-root sizing would make the widest disc 7.6% wider than the narrowest, which no eye reads as data and every eye reads as a mistake.
Proportional area belongs to stats-v3, which already square-root scales. Use that when the range spans an order of magnitude AND the number is not printed.
The brace is not decoration. Remove it and the slide is two unrelated stacked rows.
Three or four scores. At five the discs fall below the size at which a two-digit number reads from the back of a room.
